description: Header file defining classes and enums for process information, including process memory stats, process iteration, and process tree management within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a process, including memory stats, priority, policy, and methods to manipulate or retrieve process details.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Derived from ProcessInfo, provides additional methods for current process user and group info.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Manages a collection of processes, allowing containment checks and retrieval of process IDs.

classes.name: Memory
classes.description: Nested class within ProcessInfo for managing process memory statistics.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Nested class within ProcessInfo for iterating over child processes.

methods.name: MemoryStats
methods.description: Retrieves memory statistics for the process.

methods.name: USS
methods.description: Returns the USS (Unique Set Size) memory metric.

methods.name: PSS
methods.description: Returns the PSS (Proportional Set Size) memory metric.

methods.name: RSS
methods.description: Returns the RSS (Resident Set Size) memory metric.

methods.name: VSS
methods.description: Returns the VSS (Virtual Set Size) memory metric.

methods.name: FindByName
methods.description: Finds processes by name and populates a list of ProcessInfo objects.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Sends a SIGFPE signal to the process to generate a post-mortem dump.
